hope: Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Armor Slots.

features.name: Unstoppable
features.short: Once per long rest, become Unstoppable and gain an Unstoppable Die (d4; d6 at level 5) on your sheet, starting on 1. After each damage roll that deals Hit Points to a target, raise it by one. When it would pass its maximum or the scene ends, remove it and drop out. While Unstoppable: reduce physical damage by one threshold; add the die’s value to damage rolls; you can’t be Restrained or Vulnerable.

features.name: Tip
features.short: A d4 showing 4 is removed the next time you would raise it. A d6 showing 4 goes to 5 next; remove it when you would need to go past 6.

guardian.stalwart.name: Iron Will
guardian.stalwart.short: When you take physical damage, you can mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce its severity.

guardian.stalwart.name: Partners-in-Arms
guardian.stalwart.short: When an ally within Very Close range takes damage, mark an Armor Slot to reduce its severity by one threshold.

guardian.stalwart.name: Loyal Protector
guardian.stalwart.short: When an ally within Close range with 2 or fewer Hit Points would take damage, mark a Stress to sprint to their side and take it instead.

guardian.vengeance.name: Revenge
guardian.vengeance.short: When an adversary within Melee range hits you, mark 2 Stress to force it to mark a Hit Point.

guardian.vengeance.name: Act of Reprisal
guardian.vengeance.short: When an adversary damages an ally within Melee range, +1 Proficiency on your next successful attack against it.

guardian.vengeance.name: Nemesis
guardian.vengeance.short: Spend 2 Hope to Prioritize an adversary until your next rest (one at a time). When you attack it, you can swap your Hope and Fear Dice results.
